newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Jinro shares go limit-down on loan default news.
newsitem.headline: Jinro shares go limit-down on loan default news.

text.p: Shares of the Jinro Group's two listed companies fell by their daily limit in early trading on Tuesday on news that the group's distiller flagship had failed to honour repayments of promissory notes.
Jinro Ind. fell 400 won to its daily lower limit of 4,620, while Jinro General Foods dropped 300 won to its limit of 3,560.

Jinro Ltd, South Korea's largest distiller, defaulted on repayments of promissory notes worth about eight billion won on Monday, Jinro's main creditor Commercial Bank of Korea said on Tuesday. Trading of Jinro Ltd was suspended for Tuesday because of the default.
An official at the bank said final default, which would trigger formal court-receivership proceedings, would be avoided if Jinro meets a final payment deadline on Tuesday.
